changelog.name: v0.4.1
changelog.body:
## GPS Setter v0.4.1

A fix for the in-app updater.

### 🐞 Fixes
- Tapping **Update** in the "Update available" dialog no longer crashes the app on Android 14 and later. (varma322/android-gps-setter#26)

The fix only works once you're running 0.4.1. On 0.3.0 or 0.4.0, tapping Update in the app still crashes, so get this version from here or through LSPosed. From 0.4.1 on, in-app updates work.

The system hook hasn't changed since 0.4.0, so if you're updating from 0.4.0 you don't need to reboot. From 0.3.0, reboot once after installing.

### 📦 Downloads
- `app-foss-arm64-v8a-release.apk`: MapLibre + microG (OpenFreeMap tiles, ORS routing). No Google dependencies.
- `app-full-arm64-v8a-release.apk`: Google Maps + Play Services.

Requires LSPosed (or a compatible Xposed framework). Enable the module and reboot.

changelog.name: v0.4.0
changelog.body:
## GPS Setter v0.4.0

A redesigned app with four tabs, multi-stop routes you can save, and a Stop that gives apps your real location back right away.

### ✨ New
- **New layout**: a bottom bar with four tabs (**Teleport**, **Routes**, **Targets** and **Saved**) replaces the side drawer, with a new darker look. The light theme is still there. (varma322/android-gps-setter#15)
- **Teleport**:
  - A panel shows whether spoofing is live, and the exact coordinates, which you can copy.
  - Paste coordinates from the clipboard straight into search.
  - A D-pad nudges the spot by 1, 5 or 10 m, even while spoofing.
  - A **Jitter** slider (up to 25 m) replaces the old random-position switch. (varma322/android-gps-setter#18)
- **Routes**:
  - Tap as many stops as you like. Stops between the start and the destination show as numbered markers.
  - Speed presets (walk 4, run 10, bike 18, car 50 km/h), or a slider up to 300 km/h, and an optional speed variation.
  - Play a route once, in a loop or back and forth.
  - Pause, resume or skip to the next stop. Playback slows down for sharp corners.
  - Change speed and variation while a route is playing. (varma322/android-gps-setter#19, varma322/android-gps-setter#25)
- **Saved**:
  - Spots and routes in one list, with filters and a thumbnail of each route.
  - Save a route from the Routes tab and open it later with all its stops.
  - Import or paste GPX and GeoJSON tracks, and export routes as GPX.
  - Undo a delete. (varma322/android-gps-setter#20, varma322/android-gps-setter#25)
- **Targets**:
  - Shows the Xposed framework and which processes the module is loaded in.
  - Lists the scoped apps, and lets you add or remove apps from the scope.
  - With the system hook off, you can switch spoofing off for a single app. (varma322/android-gps-setter#21)
- **Clean stop**: pressing Stop now clears the fake location from Android and from Google Play services. Apps get your real location again straight away, instead of only after you open Google Maps. Location switches off for about 2 seconds while this happens. (varma322/android-gps-setter#23)

### 🔁 Changed
- Teleport, Start route and the quick-settings tiles now ask you to turn Location on when it's off, instead of starting a spoof that can't work. (varma322/android-gps-setter#23, varma322/android-gps-setter#24)
- Brighter dark maps on both builds, and compact sliders. The route options fold into one line, and the app stays in portrait. (varma322/android-gps-setter#22)

### 🐞 Fixes
- Start and stop now apply system-wide without a reboot on Vector. The framework never sent setting changes to the system process, so changes didn't reach it until a reboot. (varma322/android-gps-setter#16)
- The keyboard no longer pushes the route panel up over the search bar. (varma322/android-gps-setter#22)

### 📦 Downloads
- `app-foss-arm64-v8a-release.apk`: MapLibre + microG (OpenFreeMap tiles, ORS routing). No Google dependencies.
- `app-full-arm64-v8a-release.apk`: Google Maps + Play Services.

Requires LSPosed (or a compatible Xposed framework). Enable the module and reboot. **If you're updating from 0.3.0, reboot once after installing** so the system hook loads the new version.

changelog.name: v0.3.0
changelog.body:
## GPS Setter v0.3.0

A real light theme, working map types, and a one-tap zoom toggle on the map.

### ✨ New
- **Map types**: the **Map** setting (Normal / Satellite / Terrain / Hybrid) now works, and the map updates as soon as you come back from Settings. The FOSS build gets keyless satellite imagery (Esri), terrain (OpenTopoMap) and hybrid (imagery with road and place labels). (#12)
- **Light theme**: the **Dark theme** setting (Light / Dark / Follow system) now actually works. Before, the app always stayed dark. Panels, dialogs, menus and the map style all switch immediately, and your choice is kept after a restart. (#10)
- **Map scale toggle**: tap the crosshair button to switch the map between about **1 km** and about **100 m** across the screen. The map stays centred and your selected location doesn't change. (#8)

### 🔁 Changed
- The crosshair button no longer jumps to your current location on tap. **Long-press** it to do that.

### 🐞 Fixes
- No more crash when the crosshair button is tapped, or a search result or your current location arrives, before the map has finished loading.

### 🛠 Build
- Gradle now runs on Java 21 automatically (foojay toolchain resolver), so you no longer need to set `JAVA_HOME` by hand.

### 📦 Downloads
- `app-foss-arm64-v8a-release.apk`: MapLibre + microG (OpenFreeMap tiles, ORS routing). No Google dependencies.
- `app-full-arm64-v8a-release.apk`: Google Maps + Play Services.

Requires LSPosed (or a compatible Xposed framework). Enable the module and reboot.

[https://github.com/varma322/android-gps-setter/releases/tag/v0.3.0](url)

## GPS Setter v0.2.0

A big one — brand-new glassmorphism dark UI and A→B route playback over real roads.

### ✨ New
- **New look**: dark glassmorphism UI across the app, with a dark map style.
- **Accent colour picker** in Settings (Blue / Green / Violet / Amber / Pink), applied app-wide.
- **Route mode**: tap **A** and **B** on the map to travel a real road route between them.
  - Road routing via **OpenRouteService** with an automatic **OSRM** fallback (no key needed for the fallback).
  - **Directions sheet**: named start/end, swap A↔B, re-pick a point, adjustable speed (±), live distance & ETA.
  - **Travelling sheet**: live distance travelled, current speed and time-to-arrival, with a smooth **speed ramp from 0** at the start.
- **GPX route playback** with altitude / speed / bearing motion, so spoofed fixes move realistically.
- **Favorites import/export** (JSON via the system file picker).
- **Quick Settings tiles** for favorite locations, plus a Stop action on the notification.

### 🛠 Improvements
- Lat/lng now stored with full double precision (~1 m instead of ~coarse float).
- Update check only offers strictly newer releases.
- Dependencies moved from alpha to stable; Dependabot re-enabled.
- Toolchain: **AGP 8.13.2 / Gradle 8.14.3, libxposed 102, compileSdk 37**.

### 🐞 Fixes
- Favorite toasts, search delay, joystick, and notification bugs.
- Dead code removed; CI now builds and runs unit tests on every push/PR.

### 📦 Downloads
- `app-foss-arm64-v8a-release.apk` — MapLibre + microG (OpenFreeMap tiles, ORS routing). No Google dependencies.
- `app-full-arm64-v8a-release.apk` — Google Maps + Play Services.

Requires LSPosed (or a compatible Xposed framework). Enable the module and reboot.

First release of this fork.

- Migrated to the modern libxposed API (no more deprecated-feature warning)
- System-wide spoofing on Android 12+ with continuous fix generation
- Fixed system hooks on Android 11–13
- FOSS build maps fixed (OpenFreeMap)
- Numerous bug fixes (favorites, search, joystick, notifications, precision)

readme:
# GPS Setter An Xposed module that sets your device's location, built on the modern [libxposed](https://github.com/libxposed/api) API for LSPosed 2.x / Vector. Fork of [jqssun/android-gps-setter](https://github.com/jqssun/android-gps-setter), which builds on [Android1500/GpsSetter](https://github.com/Android1500/GpsSetter). ## Screenshots

## Features - System-wide spoofing on Android 12+: every location fix (GPS, network, fused) is replaced inside the system server, so apps don't need to be scoped one by one. - Continuous 1 Hz fix generation, so Google Play services apps follow the set location with Google Location Accuracy left on, even indoors with no GPS signal. - Real location during emergencies: while an emergency call/SMS is active (Android 14+), real fixes pass through untouched. - Start, stop and location changes apply immediately, without a reboot. - Clean stop: pressing Stop clears the fake location from Android and from Google Play services, so apps get your real location back straight away. - **Teleport**: live status and exact coordinates, paste coordinates from the clipboard, a D-pad that nudges the spot by 1, 5 or 10 m, and a jitter slider. - **Routes**: multi-stop routes along real roads, with numbered via stops; speed presets (walk, run, bike, car) or any speed up to 300 km/h, with optional variation; play once, in a loop or back and forth; pause, skip to the next stop, and slow down for sharp corners. Speed can be changed while playing. - **Saved**: spots and routes in one list with thumbnails; saved routes keep their stops; import or paste GPX and GeoJSON tracks, and export routes as GPX. - **Targets**: the framework, the processes the module is loaded in, and its scope, all managed from the app. - On-screen joystick to nudge the location live. ## Requirements - Rooted device with **LSPosed 2.x or Vector** (libxposed API 101+). LSPosed 1.x cannot load this module. - Android 8.1+. System-wide spoofing of live updates needs Android 12+. ## Setup 1. Enable **GPS Setter** in LSPosed and tick **System Framework** in its scope (optionally also tick individual apps). 2. Reboot. 3. Open the app, pick a location on the map and tap **Teleport here**. After updating the module, reboot once so the system hook loads the new version. ## Notes - Apps protected by Google Play's anti-tamper (those bundling `libpairipcore.so`) crash if scoped — don't scope them; rely on the system hook. - Only enable one location-spoofing module at a time. Source code & issues: https://github.com/varma322/android-gps-setter
readmeZh:
# GPS 设置器 一个 Xposed 模块，用于设置设备的位置，基于现代 [libxpose](https://github.com/libxposed/api) LSPosed 2.x / Vector 的 API。 [jqssun/android-gps-setter](https://github.com/jqssun/android-gps-setter)的分支， 它建立在 [Android1500/GpsSetter](https://github.com/Android1500/GpsSetter) 之上。 ## 截图

## 特点 - Android 12+ 上的系统范围欺骗：每个位置修复（GPS、网络、融合） 在系统服务器内部替换，因此应用程序不需要一一确定范围。 - 连续 1 Hz 修复生成，因此 Google Play 服务应用程序遵循该设置 即使在没有 GPS 信号的室内，也可以在 Google 定位精度保持开启的情况下定位。 - 紧急情况下的真实位置：紧急呼叫/短信激活时 （Android 14+），真正的修复未受影响。 - 启动、停止和位置更改立即应用，无需重新启动。 - 清除停止：按“停止”可清除 Android 和 Android 中的虚假位置 Google Play 服务，因此应用程序可以立即获取您的真实位置。 - **传送**：实时状态和精确坐标，从 剪贴板、可将点微移 1、5 或 10 m 的方向键以及抖动滑块。 - **路线**：沿着真实道路的多站路线，并带有停靠站编号；速度 预设（步行、跑步、自行车、汽车）或任何高达 300 公里/小时的速度，可选 变化；播放一次、循环或来回播放；暂停，跳至下一个 停下来，并在急转弯时减速。播放时可以改变速度。 - **已保存**：地点和路线在一个列表中，并带有缩略图；保存的路线保留其 停止；导入或粘贴 GPX 和 GeoJSON 轨迹，并将路线导出为 GPX。 - **目标**：框架、加载模块的进程及其 范围，全部由应用程序管理。 - 屏幕上的操纵杆可实时移动位置。 ## 要求 - 使用 **LSPosed 2.x 或 Vector** (libxposed API 101+) 获取 root 权限的设备。 LSPoded 1.x 无法加载此模块。 - 安卓8.1+。系统范围内的实时更新欺骗需要 Android 12+。 ## 设置 1. 在LSPod中启用**GPS Setter**并在其范围内勾选**系统框架** （也可以选择勾选单个应用程序）。 2. 重新启动。 3. 打开应用程序，在地图上选择一个位置，然后点击**传送到此处**。 更新模块后，重新启动一次，以便系统挂钩加载新版本。 ## 注释 - 受 Google Play 防篡改保护的应用程序（捆绑“libpairipcore.so”的应用程序） 如果范围限定则崩溃——不限定范围；依赖系统钩子。 - 一次仅启用一个位置欺骗模块。 源代码和问题：https://github.com/varma322/android-gps-setter
